dn19:33.7: sukhamedhetha → sukho bhavetha (machasaṃ); sukhaṃ bhaveyyātha (syā); sukhamedheyyātha (PTS); sukhā bhaveyyātha (kā)
dn19:44.15: bhavaṃ → āsanamudakaṃ pādyāṃ madhukalpaṃ ca pāyasam pratihṛhṇehi brahma agramahiharā mite āsanamudakā pādyāṃ madhukalapaṃ ca pāyasam pratigṛhṇami hovinda agramahiharāhi me (mahāvastu)
dn19:44.21: kiñcimabhipatthitanti → udakaṃ paṭigaṇhātu no bhavaṃ agasaṃ bhavantaṃ pucchāmi agasaṃ kurutu no bhavaṃ (jātaka 509 dāṣṭe dharme hitārthaṃ vā samparāyasukhāya vā kṛtāvakā śo pācechayaṃ yaṃ me manasi prārthitam – mahāvastu)
dn19:45.11: brahmalokanti → pṛcchāmi brahmaṇaṃ sanatkumāraṃ kāṃkaṣi akāṃkaṣi parivāriyeṣu kathaṃkaro kintikaro kimācaraṃ prāpnoti manujo mṛtaṃ brahmalokam (mahāvastu)
dn19:45.16: brahmalokanti → hitvā mamatvaṃ manujesu brahme ekotībhūto karuṇo viviktaඃ nirāmagandho virato maithunāto prāpnoti manujo mṛtaṃ brahmalokam (mahāvastu)
dn19:46.14: nivutabrahmalokā”ti → ke āmagandhā manujesu brahma etaṃ na vinda tad vīra brūhi yenāvṛtā vārivahā kukulā apāyikā nirvṛtā brahmalokam (mahāvastu)
dn19:46.20: nivutabrahmalokāti → krodho mṛṣavāda kathaṃkatā ca ..... atimāno ..... irṣyā hiṃsā paravādaroṣaṇa ..... (mahāvastu)
dn19:47.9: rame → āmantremi mahārāja reṇu bhūmipate tava pravrajāmi prajahitvā rājyaṃ paurohityaṃ ca me (mahāvastu)
dn19:47.15: pājahi → sa vedasti ūnaṃ kāmehi vayaṃ te pūrayāma taṃ ko vā bhavantaṃ heṭheti ..... bhavān pītā vayaṃ putro mā govinda pravrajāhi (mahāvastu)
dn19:47.21: abhāsatha → na asati ūnaṃ kāmehi heṭhayitā na vidyati amanuṣyavacanaṃ śrætvā ..... (mahāvastu)
dn19:47.23: kevale → amanuṣyo kathaṃvarṇo kiṃ vā athimahāṣata yasya vācaṃ śrætvā jahāsi asmākaṃ gāhaṃ ca kevalam (mahāvastu)
dn19:47.27: kusapattaparitthato → sarvato ya yaṣṭukāmasya upavustatya me sataඃ agni prajavālito āsi kuśvīraparicchedo (mahāvastu)
dn19:47.31: rame → taneඃ hammi prādurabhud brahma loke sanātano yasyāhaṃ vacanaṃ śrætvā jahāmi yuṣamākaṃ gṛhaṃ ca kevalam (mahāvastu)
dn19:47.35: aññathā → śraddadāma vayaṃ bhavato yathā govindo bhāṣati amanuṣyavacanaṃ śrātvā kathaṃ vartema anyathā (mahāvastu)
dn19:50.5: khantībalasamāhitā → sacejjahatha kāmāni yatra rakatāඃ pṛthagjanāඃ sasataṃ bhaved dṛṭhibhavatha kṣantibala samāhitā (mahāvastu)
dn19:50.9: brahmalokūpapattiyā”ti → eṣa mārgo brahmapure eṣa mārgaඃ sanātanaඃ saddharmaviyibhirābyāto brahmalokoppattaye (mahāvastu)
